title: Boots Malone
description: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: His Girl Friday
description: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.

title: Our Wife
description: A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

title: Gidget Goes to Rome
description: Teenage Gidget (Cindy Carol) and boyfriend Moondoggie (James Darren) cause romantic confusion on vacation in Italy.

title: Her Husband's Affairs
description: A wacky woman (Lucille Ball) somehow gets the credit for her husband's (Franchot Tone) advertising genius.

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).

title: Phffft!
description: Being with a blonde (Kim Novak) and a bachelor makes a divorced lawyer (Jack Lemmon) and TV writer (Judy Holliday) want to be back together.

title: The Mating of Millie
description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

title: Cactus Flower
description: A dentist (Walter Matthau) has his prim assistant (Ingrid Bergman) pose as his wife to discourage his kooky girlfriend (Goldie Hawn).

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: Five Easy Pieces
description: A former concert pianist (Jack Nicholson) who works in an oil field takes his waitress girlfriend (Karen Black) to visit his wealthy, cultured family.

title: Fire Down Below
description: A woman (Rita Hayworth) without a passport divides West Indies smugglers (Robert Mitchum, Jack Lemmon), then a fire threatens to sink a freighter.

title: Let's Do It Again
description: A composer's (Ray Milland) singing-and-dancing wife (Jane Wyman) tries to make him jealous, but it backfires into a divorce.

title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
description: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: A Woman of Distinction
description: Scandalous rumors link the dean (Rosalind Russell) of a women's college with a professor of astronomy (Ray Milland) from England.

title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
description: A bookie's (William Holden) innocent new secretary (Lucille Ball) thinks she's working in a real-estate office.

title: It Happened to Jane
description: A Maine lobsterwoman (Doris Day) has her lawyer (Jack Lemmon) sue a railroad tycoon (Ernie Kovacs) over a spoiled shipment.

title: The Last Hurrah
description: An aging New England politician struggles to maintain his position as mayor in a hard-fought and questionable campaign.

title: To Sir, With Love
description: Unable to find employment in his field, a black engineer accepts a teaching position in a tough East End London school.

description: A former concert pianist (Jack Nicholson) who works in an oil field takes his waitress girlfriend (Karen Black) to visit his wealthy, cultured family.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: The Running Man
description: An insurance man (Alan Bates) gets chummy in Spain with a couple (Laurence Harvey, Lee Remick) who have collected on a fake death.

title: Harriet Craig
description: A businessman's (Wendell Corey) wife (Joan Crawford) is obsessed with running their household and his life, her way.

title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
description: A dreamer (Jerry Lewis) and a British con man (Terry-Thomas) plot to steal an oil-drill invention and sell it to the Arabs.

title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
description: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: It Should Happen to You
description: An executive (Peter Lawford) and a filmmaker (Jack Lemmon) woo a model (Judy Holliday) famous for having her name on a billboard.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: Salome
description: A dancing princess (Rita Hayworth) loves a Roman commander (Stewart Granger) and inspires King Herod (Charles Laughton) to have John the Baptist beheaded.

title: Theodora Goes Wild
description: A small-town New England author (Irene Dunne) meets her racy novel's urbane illustrator (Melvyn Douglas) in Manhattan.

title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
description: A lusty landlord (Jack Lemmon) eyes a coed (Carol Lynley) who is trying to live platonically with her boyfriend (Dean Jones).
